metadata.description: Nowely's plugins for Codex and Claude Code.

plugins.name: entrust
plugins.description: Orchestrate native subagents in Codex or Claude with scoped tasks, independent verification and attributable results. In Claude, the codex adapter also launches external Codex agents with per-call rights, worktrees, evidence gates and receipts. External-run helpers include cleanup, experiments, an advisor, swarms and feedback reports.

plugins.name: terse
plugins.description: Three skills you invoke to assess and improve a standalone text: `audit` measures it, `rethink` agrees its shape, and `rewrite` writes it. `clarity` is reader-side guidance Claude may choose while writing an answer, plan, commit, PR, comment, message, or agent brief; it starts no agents. The deep skills use agents, work in a run directory and ask before applying a text to your files.
